_doc: Hand curation read by run.py. include_qids: extra Wikidata items to fetch (group in include_qid_group). include: whole hand-written records (need name, group, ll, place, kind, about, url). exclude: qids / ids / name_patterns (regex, case-insensitive) dropped after merge. tier1: qids / names forced to tier 1. group_override: qid -> group.
